_README: Provenance for every vendored vector file in this directory. tests/vectors/load.ts re-hashes each file at load time and fails the suite when the bytes no longer match the sha256 recorded here, so drift is visible rather than silent. See README.md for the refresh procedure.

bip340-schnorr.csv.description: The official BIP-340 Schnorr signature test vectors, vendored verbatim from the bitcoin/bips repository. Not one byte was altered; the file retains its upstream CRLF line endings.
bip340-schnorr.csv.notes: The checksum is of the retrieved bytes. The upstream file has been effectively frozen since the 2022-07-27 commit that added the variable-length message vectors (indices 15-18).

nip01-events.json.description: Cross-implementation NIP-01 event vectors. NIP-01 publishes NO official vector file, and this file is not one. Each event was produced and signed by a third-party Nostr implementation and was published or served by at least one NAMED external implementation; the named attestations are recorded per vector inside the file under provenance.attestations. No event here was generated by Ostrilo.
nip01-events.json.upstream_url_note: There is no single upstream URL because there is no upstream file. The assembled sources are listed below, and each individual vector carries its own attestation list.

sources.url: wss://nos.lol, wss://relay.damus.io, wss://offchain.pub, wss://nostr.mom, wss://relay.primal.net, wss://relay.mostr.pub

nip01-events.json.notes: The sha256 is of this repository's assembled file, not of an upstream artifact. It detects local drift; it is not an upstream attestation. Every event was independently checked at assembly time: the id was recomputed from the serialized fields and the signature verified against the pubkey, using @noble/curves directly rather than Ostrilo's code, so the selection is not circular. Twelve of the fourteen vectors carry two or more distinct named implementations; two carry exactly one - kind-3-contacts-json-content and kind-1-hello-world-secret-key-one, which come from the go-nostr fixture only because both are old enough that no queried relay still holds them. Those counts are recorded per vector and are not rounded up.
